description: This file contains functions for generating and managing user privilege files and sharing permissions in a vtiger CRM environment. It handles creation of privilege files that include user, role, group, and permission data, as well as functions for populating temporary tables used for access control calculations, and for extracting detailed sharing rules per module and related modules.

methods.name: createUserPrivilegesfile
methods.description: Generates a PHP file with detailed user privilege information including roles, group memberships, permissions, and user info, used for quick access control checks.

methods.name: createUserSharingPrivilegesfile
methods.description: Creates a PHP file that stores sharing permissions for a specific user, including module-specific sharing rules, role, group, and user data, often used to quickly determine data access rights.

methods.name: getUserModuleSharingObjects
methods.description: Retrieves sharing data (roles, groups, users) that are permitted to access data for a specific module for a given user, based on current sharing and permission settings.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleSharingArray
methods.description: Fetches sharing permissions for a related module based on shared module permissions, sharing rules, and parent relationships, used to propagate sharing rules across related data.

methods.name: constructArray
methods.description: Converts a PHP array into a string representation suitable for inclusion in generated PHP files, maintaining array structure.

methods.name: constructSingleStringValueArray
methods.description: Turns an array of string values into a PHP array string, with keys preserved, for easy inclusion in privilege files.

methods.name: constructSingleStringKeyAndValueArray
methods.description: Converts an associative array into a PHP string with key-value pairs, escaping values for safety in privilege files.

methods.name: constructSingleStringKeyValueArray
methods.description: Creates a string representation of an array with key-value pairs, escaping string values for safe PHP code generation.

methods.name: constructSingleArray
methods.description: Generates a string for an array of values for quick inclusion in privilege files.

methods.name: constructSingleCharArray
methods.description: Creates a PHP string array of string values, used for enumerations like roles or groups.

methods.name: constructTwoDimensionalArray
methods.description: Serializes a two-dimensional array into PHP code for inclusion in privilege files.

methods.name: constructTwoDimensionalValueArray
methods.description: Serializes a two-dimensional array with values only, for module sharing permission arrays.

methods.name: constructTwoDimensionalCharIntSingleArray
methods.description: Creates a PHP string for a 2D array with string keys and array of integers as values.

methods.name: constructTwoDimensionalCharIntSingleValueArray
methods.description: Creates a PHP string for a 2D array with string keys and array of integers as values, simplified for specific permission structures.

methods.name: populateSharingtmptables
methods.description: Populates temporary database tables with users' sharing and permission data for faster access control checks.

methods.name: populateSharingPrivileges
methods.description: Inserts sharing permission data for users or groups into temporary database tables based on precomputed PHP arrays.

methods.name: populateRelatedSharingPrivileges
methods.description: Populates sharing permission data for related modules (user-to-related, group-to-related) into temporary database tables, handling both read and write permissions, used for fine-grained access control in related module sharing scenarios.
